title: openai: /v1/chat.completions parity for params, roles, stop/logprobs and response formatting (streaming + functions)
author: Aisha Patel
release_notes: Add OpenAI /v1/chat.completions parity: support for params (temperature/top_p/n/max_tokens), message roles mapping, stop sequences and logprobs, improved streaming stability and function/tool calling compatibility. Backwards compatible with existing Redwood API. Includes integration tests and docs updates.
description: Motivation: customers rely on OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat.completions semantics when migrating to Redwood. This PR implements parity for params (temperature, top_p, n, max_tokens), roles handling in message arrays, stop sequence semantics, logprobs in non-streaming responses, response formatting consistency (including content-filtering and structured output) and streaming stability improvements related to chunk framing and reconnects. It also tightens behavior for function/tool calling to match OpenAI: single-call deterministic selection when function_call is requested and consistent function name/arguments formatting in structured outputs. Checklist: - [x] param mapping and validation - [x] roles preserved and normalized (system/user/assistant) - [x] stop sequence behavior matches OpenAI semantics (early termination and multi-sequence support) - [x] logprobs returned under same schema as OpenAI when requested - [x] streaming SSE framing fixed to avoid duplicate tokens on reconnect - [x] function/tool call semantics aligned with OpenAI (name/args) - [x] added integration tests against compatibility harness - [x] docs and examples updated (openai-compat.md) Notes: - Kept changes backwards-compatible for existing Redwood endpoints by gating OpenAI compatibility behind the /openai/compat handler. - Telemetry added for compatibility mode to track parity regressions (metric: openai_compat.parity_errors). - Performance: validated that streaming changes do not increase median latency for small payloads; a minor increase in peak memory during reconnect was observed but within acceptable bounds. - See linked Linear items ENG-1843 and ENG-1901 for product acceptance criteria and rollout plan.
